# A lightweight drop-in replacement for your Postgres read replica.

Same SQL, same answers. **But [extremely fast](https://masondata.ai/#fast) for analytical queries.**

One query over 10 million rows: the Postgres primary took 15.7 seconds, Mason as its read replica took 0.193 seconds, and both returned the same answer to the same SQL: 81 times faster.

```
SELECT response_code, count(*)
FROM requests
GROUP BY response_code
```

| 404 | 846,118 |

title: Qwen/Qwen3.8-27B
description_en: HuggingFace model: Qwen/Qwen3.8-27B. Pipeline: image-text-to-text. Downloads: 6,047,011.

title: MyClaw 3.0
description_en: Build an always-on AI team with shared memory. MyClaw lets you build your own AI team with OpenClaw, Claude Code, Codex, Hermes Agent, Pi, and more. Give each teammate its own role, tools, skills, and choice of 50+ models, with shared memory across your team. Your agents run on always-on cloud computers, use your apps, access data, and handle recurring tasks even when you're offline. Assign work from the web, Slack, Telegram, or WhatsApp. No server setup or lock-in to a single AI provider.

title: Granular.Build
description_en: Put your AI agents to work in a visual workspace. Big ideas shouldn't require a dozen AI tools or a programming background. Granular brings your models, agents, files, and project context into one visual workspace. Give a boss agent your goal, let it coordinate specialists in parallel, and watch apps, designs, or videos take shape with live previews. Bring your own AI, use built-in terminals and plugins when you need them, and keep each project's memory and files in one place. Go from first plan to published result.

title: Airbot
description_en: The AI chief of staff that texts you first. Most AI assistants wait for you to ask. Airbot texts you first. It checks the conversations, meetings, and customer updates spread across email, Slack, your calendar, and CRM, then brings you only the priorities that matter. Behind every message is work already prepared: a drafted response, a meeting brief, a booking, or a CRM change. Approve what should happen directly in WhatsApp or iMessage. Airbot helps founders and lean teams stay on top of work without living in their notifications.

title: Viktor Code
description_en: Coding agents know your repo. Viktor knows your company.. Coding agents know your repository. Viktor knows your company: your customers, your metrics and the decisions behind the work. So you give him a business outcome, not a ticket. He splits it into the technical and the non-technical work. He opens pull requests on your GitHub, GitLab or Bitbucket repos and brings them back for your review. His projects belong to the whole team, in Slack, Teams or Discord. Anyone can code now. Free to start, with up to $100 in credits.

title: Clam AI
description_en: Your inbox, safely shared with AI agents. Your inbox is a master key: password resets, bank alerts and health reports all run through it. Clam lets AI agents work in your email without holding that key. You write the rules in plain English, like "Read travel email. Draft replies. Never send." Each agent sees and does only what its rules allow, and you see everything it tries. We start with Gmail. We are building the permission layer for MCP: one that understands what the data means and the context of every request.

title: SparrowDesk Phone Calls
description_en: Phone support in the same inbox as email, chat & WhatsApp. Phone support inside your helpdesk. SparrowDesk Phone Calls puts calls in the same inbox as email, chat and WhatsApp. Buy a number in 51 countries, route callers with a visual IVR or an AI agent, and answer from the browser. Every call is recorded, transcribed and handled like any other ticket. No per-seat voice fees: pay as you go from a prepaid Voice Wallet.

title: Claude Ship
description_en: Ship code as fast as you can write it. Ship code as fast as you can write it: Claude Ship reviews, fixes, and approves pull requests, taking each one from opened to ready to merge. Code Review posts verified findings on each PR. PR Steward (beta) fixes failing CI, conflicts, and review feedback, but never merges. Claude Approvals (beta) approves routine changes under your team's policy file and asks a human about the rest. Run /ship in Claude Code to push, open the PR, and hand it off. For Claude Team and Enterprise on GitHub.

title: frwrd.to
description_en: Your link in bio, sorted by your AI in one message. Send your AI assistant your current link in bio or your website. It keeps what matters, matches your brand and publishes the page in every language you need. Campaigns end on their own, and you can edit everything by hand too.

title: Snag by Parallel
description_en: Find the best deals on products from your agents. Find the best deals on the products you've been asking ChatGPT, Claude, and other agents about. Snag turns those conversations into a wishlist you import in one click, matches each item to the exact product, and checks prices across stores. Lists are sorted by best deal, every price is rated against its list price, and any list can be shared with a link. 100% free, in time for Black Friday. Powered by the Parallel Shopping API and Parallel Images API.

title: Canva MCP
description_en: Turn any AI agent into a creative powerhouse. Canva MCP opens Canva's creative tools to AI agents and developers. Generate editable designs, images and videos, remove backgrounds, resize assets and automate on-brand creative workflows with MCP, REST APIs and CLI.

title: tday.com
description_en: AI-recorded Screen Studio style editable demos. Most features ship without a demo video. A good one takes hours to script, record, retake, voice and edit. Ask for a demo in one line from Claude Code, Cursor or Codex. Your coding agent records your real app on your machine, localhost included, and tday adds the voice, cursor, zooms, captions and your brand. Edit any narration line, then use it in your launch, docs or changelog. Web, desktop, terminal, iPhone and Android apps. Your code never leaves your machine. Free for 5 saved demos.

title: Valley
description_en: Outbound system to find people most likely to buy from you. Valley finds the people most likely to buy from you, from live buying signals, plain-English search or your own lists. It checks each one against your ICP, researches them, and writes a personal message across LinkedIn and email. You approve every message, replies land in one inbox, and it runs from Claude or ChatGPT via MCP. Teams see 15-45% reply rates vs about 2% for cold outreach. Bolt.new booked 25 enterprise demos in 45 days. Book a demo to see it on your own leads.

title: Fompi
description_en: Personal security & privacy companion that calls out risks. Fompi sits quietly in your browser and on your Mac, and speaks up when it matters: a scam page, a phishing email, a disguised download, an AI notetaker in your call, an app on your mic, a card number headed for an AI chat. It tells you why. Free to start :)

title: Koed
description_en: Supercharged Agents!. Koed gives each coding project its own Kin: a customisable assistant that remembers how you like to work, the decisions you’ve made and what you’ve already tried. Your Kin reasons over that context to give Claude Code, Codex and Pi guidance shaped by your project, helping your agents work faster and use fewer tokens. Koed runs on-device and is free and open source. It’s available now for solo developers, with more coding agent integrations, optional cloud processing and team sharing coming soon.

title: doola MCP
description_en: Start and run your US company from your AI assistant. The doola MCP lets founders start and run a US company from ChatGPT, Claude, and any tool that supports MCP. Form an LLC or C-Corp in any of the 50 states in one chat, from account setup to submission. Already a doola customer? Connect your account and ask your AI Co-Founder for your EIN letter, formation documents and deadlines. doola Bookkeeping customers can also pull financial reports, and connected Shopify or ad accounts add sales and ad spend trends. Add mcp.doola.com as a connector.

title: Hai
description_en: Your AI assistant that actually makes the phone call. Some bookings still only happen by phone, and plenty of us dread making that call. For people who are deaf, hard of hearing, or have speech or anxiety barriers, that call can be impossible. Hai makes it for you. Tell your assistant what you need, approve the plan, and Hai places the call in any language to any business that takes bookings by phone, then reports back in text. Free to start. Built by an indie developer in Japan.

title: Pinned
description_en: Ask the city where to go tonight with your friends. Ask Pinned where to go tonight, the way you'd text a friend who knows the city. Pinned AI reads every spot nearby and brings back the three that fit your whole crew, with a reason for each. Then drop a pin with the plan, and your friends say "I'm down" in one tap. Try a real Ask at pinned.social, no download needed. Free on iPhone and Android, made in New York for people who'd rather be out than online.

title: Omi X 2.0
description_en: Omi can build anything. Your $1B idea, live in production. Omi can build anything. Omi X 2.0 is the desktop app for Mac and Windows that builds a production AI SaaS on your own Google Cloud and Firebase. New in 2.0: Point and edit lets you click any part of your running app and tell Omi what to change. Open an existing project brings in your own Next.js app; Omi tests, builds and deploys it. New projects start from a tested starter. Plan free, no card; building from $29 a month.

title: Fleetify
description_en: Open-source command center for your AI coding agents. Fleetify is a free, open-source desktop app for running AI coding agents side by side. Start sessions with Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode and seven more agents, or with OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, OpenRouter and local Ollama models. Watch them all from the Fleet hub: status, spend, tokens and live activity. Give each task its own git worktree, preview your dev server, open PRs, and install a plugin once for every agent that supports it. macOS, Windows, Linux.

title: HeroUI Pro 1.0
description_en: Premium UI components, templates, and AI tooling for React. HeroUI Pro is the premium tier of HeroUI (formerly NextUI). 118+ production-ready Pro components with 900+ examples: 65+ for React, built on Tailwind CSS v4 and React Aria (data grid, charts, kanban, agenda, rich text editor, maps, and a full AI chat kit), and 53+ for React Native on iOS and Android. Plus full-page templates, and MCP servers and Agent Skills so Cursor and Claude build with your design system. One perpetual license, unlimited projects.

title: Astor
description_en: AI Thesis Investing. Astor is the personal investing agent for thesis-driven investors. Tell Astor what you believe in, e.g. “the grid is AI’s bottleneck.” Astor builds the portfolio and explains every pick. It monitors your thesis every market day, and when the story changes, it tells you how to adjust. You approve every trade. Free to start.

title: 3way.Social MCP
description_en: Ask your AI to find link partners. You approve the deals.. 3way.Social is a fair, credit-based marketplace for link insertions and guest posts, with no cold outreach. Each site chooses what it buys and sells, links are priced on industry-standard metrics (DR, traffic, spam score), and if a link disappears you get your credits back. AI discovery finds specific pages on your topic, not just domains. The MCP brings it into Claude, Cursor or ChatGPT: ask for partner pages for your new post, then approve the deal.

title: RelayRunner
description_en: Swap multiple CI runners on-demand with zero code changes.. RelayRunner is a router for your existing CI runners, so you can use multiple providers or self-hosted options at the same time. Send each GitHub Actions job to the first free runner in your order: your own Mac, self-hosted runners, GitHub's default runners, or providers like Blacksmith and Boat. Change the order any time without touching your workflows. Open source, with a Mac app and a CLI that turn any machine into a runner on-demand.

title: MAGI-2
description_en: Sand AI's 480B model for cinematic video generation. MAGI-2 is Sand AI's flagship video generation model, creating up to 30 seconds of 1080p video with synchronized native audio. Combine up to 20 image, video, and audio references to guide characters, scenes, styles, and sound. Direct shot changes and timeline events, or edit specific parts of existing videos. Built for creators who want more control over cinematic AI video production. Available through the Sand AI platform and API.

title: Falcon by Vybe
description_en: Falcon analyzes your competitors for free, then gets to work. Get a free competitor analysis. Falcon, a Vybe agent, digs into your rivals and delivers a deep report: market landscape, feature parity, momentum, gaps left open, and competitors' go-to-market motions. The whole picture, not just a list of competitors. Want more than the report? Falcon runs on Vybe, so you can let an agent take the wheel, keep you updated on where the market is headed and turn the findings into work.

title: Juncts
description_en: Superhuman for your DMs, with AI that triages and drafts. Juncts centralizes LinkedIn, X, Instagram, WhatsApp and Telegram into one powerful, keyboard-first inbox, then lets AI do the heavy lifting. Connect Claude or ChatGPT to catch up on what you missed, triage and label conversations, and draft replies across every app. Labels, reminders, scheduled messages, split views and CRM sync built in. You set the AI's access level, and nothing sends unless you allow it. 14 days free, no card.

title: Finseo
description_en: Company brain + outreach to get your brand mentioned by AI. Finseo now acts on your AI visibility, not just measures it. Company Brain puts your website, docs, Drive, Search Console, GA4 and AI tracking into one searchable map: ask anything, get answers with sources. Outreach finds the pages AI answers cite where your brand is missing, finds the editors and drafts pitches in your brand voice, with every claim checked against your Brain before you approve.

title: Tray
description_en: macOS file manager in a screen corner. A file manager for macOS that lives in a screen corner. Drop files on the shelf, preview them, group them into a folder, drag them anywhere, or send them to the Bin — without opening Finder.

title: VibeCode.surf
description_en: AI code editor where agents build, run and test your app. VibeCode.surf is an AI code editor for your desktop. Several agents plan, write, run and test your code on your own computer, with any model. Say what you want, and a lead agent splits the job across helpers that write the code, run it and test it in a real browser. It runs on your computer with any model, from Claude and GPT to a local one, and shows what every reply costs.

title: Tendeck
description_en: Run all your Claude Code and Codex agents on one Mac board. Every coding agent becomes a card on one board. The card turns gold when an agent needs you, so nothing waits 40 minutes for a "yes". Claude Code, Codex or any agent CLI, with worktrees, account switching and files on the card. $59 once.

title: Almma's PII Guard
description_en: Catch personal data before it reaches your AI chat. A free, open-source browser extension that flags names, emails, numbers, dates and addresses in the message box of claude.ai and chat.almma.ai, and replaces them with placeholders like [NAME_1] before you send. Pasted text is held for review. Typed text is underlined in red and Send is blocked until you decide. Everything runs locally: the code contains no network calls, and the README shows how to check. MIT licensed.

title: SteerLatch
description_en: Connect MCP-compatible AIs to your computer. SteerLatch connects MCP-compatible AIs to your authorized Mac/Windows PC: files, desktop, terminal, STOP and revocable access. NEW: control your paired PC from a phone/browser after local setup, while AI works. SteerLatch Context Hub shares project memory and messages across agents. Official apps are live on Apple App Store (iPhone companion) and Microsoft Store (Windows). Free 3-month trial: 3 PCs, 5,000 MCP calls/month, no card.

title: MemoryWorks
description_en: Company memory for people and AI agents. MemoryWorks is the memory layer for engineering organizations. It captures decisions, context and know-how from your team's sources and makes it available to people and AI agents, always tied back to where it came from. Works with ChatGPT and Claude Code via an MCP server. Open source (AGPL-3.0).

title: mindyOne
description_en: Your Instagram DMs. Now with an AI receptionist.. mindyOne is an AI receptionist for your Instagram DMs. When someone asks for a time, it answers from your prices and hours, offers only slots that are really free, and books the appointment right in the chat: a name, a read-back and a yes. It also reschedules and cancels, says it's an AI, and steps back when you reply. Built for businesses whose DMs end in a booking: trainers, salons, photographers, studios, consultants. Build yours from a description and talk to it before you sign up.

title: Cullman
description_en: Faster voice agent evals, from simulation to production. Cullman is an evals platform for building and shipping reliable voice agents. Evaluate every prompt, model, and voice change with text simulations, voice simulations, and real human testers, scored against your custom rubrics. Compare versions, catch regressions, and validate improvements before you deploy. Run simulations in minutes and human tests in days. Then keep evaluating in production with live-call scoring, call traces, and split tests. Test, deploy, and improve your agent in one place.

title: Continual-ARC
description_en: OpenClaw doesn't learn from experience. Does your agent?. Left to themselves, OpenClaw, Hermes Agent and Prime Agent failed to memorize puzzles they'd already seen, and didn't get better at solving new ones. In contrast, a small 9B model trained on the same stream got better at both. Run yours on the open benchmark.

title: Statefold
description_en: Coding agents that keep working while you're away. Statefold runs your coding agent (Codex, Claude Code, OpenCode, Pi or Gemini CLI) on its own cloud computer, so it keeps working after you close your laptop. Give it a task and it writes the code, tests it and opens a pull request. If a check fails or a reviewer leaves a comment, the agent sees it and fixes it in the same conversation. Review the changes and merge from your computer or your phone. It works with the subscription or API key you already pay for.

title: file.spot
description_en: File transfer for creative professionals. Share large files with clients on a delivery page in your own branding. Previews of every file, five layouts, and no account needed to download. Stored in the EU, no ads, and your work is never used for AI training.

title: Scribase MCP Server
description_en: A Postgres backend your coding agent sets up by MCP. Scribase MCP Server gives Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, Windsurf, Zed and VS Code 97 tools over a hosted Postgres backend: database, auth, storage, realtime and functions. The agent creates the project, runs SQL and migrations, and writes the keys into your app. Reads run at once; destructive changes wait for your confirm, and schema changes can be gated on a passing row-level-security test. Remote server, nothing to run. Free for 14 days, no card, then from $5 a project.

title: Tendor
description_en: Write it or ask it, from anywhere on Windows. Write down a thought or ask AI without leaving what you're doing. Press a hotkey and Tendor opens over any app on Windows 11. Type to save a task or note, start with ? to ask AI, or ?! to send your screen too. The AI reads your tasks and notes from any day, asking before it opens an older one. Save instructions as Skills and run them with /name, or type /newskill and the AI writes one. Use your own key from 8 providers. Plain Markdown, no account, free to start.

title: TouchDeck
description_en: Turn your iPhone or iPad into a control deck for your Mac. TouchDeck turns your iPhone, iPad or iPhone Duo into a control deck for your Mac: keys, rotary dials, sliders and a jog wheel. Pick any Mac app and it builds a deck from the shortcuts in that app's own menus, and your deck switches by itself when you change apps. One key can run a whole workflow. Pairs with a 4-digit code over local Wi-Fi, end-to-end encrypted, no account. The Mac app is free; 7-day free trial on iPhone and iPad.

title: Notely
description_en: Notion-grade power & BYOK AI, stored locally in SQLite. Ditch $120/yr note subscriptions. Notely is a 100% offline-first Windows 11 workspace backed by SQLite WAL + FTS5 search—no accounts, no telemetry, free forever. Open up to 24 Chrome-style tabs, write rich notes with resizable tables, sticky notes, built-in calculator & live inline stopwatch timers, compare word-level version history, lock sensitive notes with Argon2id + AES-256-GCM, export losslessnotely/PDF via Print Studio, and opt in to BYOK Gemini or GroqCloud AI.

title: Bento terminal
description_en: A multi-pane terminal workspace for one project. Bento is a full-screen terminal workspace for one project: preview and edit files, review changes, run builds, open a shell, and run coding agents beside the preview. No more multi-tab terminal juggling — one Bento window holds the workspace, with shell tabs inside. Let your AI agent do the work while you watch changes in real time, see what is staged for git, and run tests while the dev server keeps running. In-app updates. Single Go binary, MIT, macOS, Linux, Windows.

title: PartGenie 2.0
description_en: The AI workspace for hardware engineering. PartGenie is the AI workspace for hardware engineering, connecting design, component intelligence, sourcing, and manufacturing in one place. Explore 60M+ electronic components, get datasheet-grounded answers, find verified alternatives & ECAD models, analyze BOMs, and move from engineering decisions to real-world sourcing and PCB/PCBA manufacturing. From design to build. Anywhere.

title: K-Stra
description_en: Geomarketing for Australia, with an AI that does the maths. Where should we open next? K-Stra answers that for retailers, franchise networks and property teams in Australia. Give it an address and it draws the real drive-time catchment, then shows who lives there, what they earn and spend, which competitors are nearby, what property costs and an estimate of road and foot traffic. An AI assistant sets up the analysis from a plain-English question and shows the price in credits before anything runs. Free to explore, no subscription required.

title: Ohhai
description_en: Type messy, send clean: an AI keyboard for iPhone. Ohhai is an AI keyboard for iPhone. Type fast, mistakes and all, and Return puts in the clean phrase.
